t: You're standing where the Peckham Hippodrome once stood. It was a theatre and later a cinema, and it has since been demolished and replaced by the Gaumont Palace Cinema. The Hippodrome was designed by Ernest Augustus Runtz, an architect best known for his theatre work in London. He died in 1913. That makes this a good spot to picture Peckham's entertainment past, even though the original building is gone.
